hook.text: Safari is the second most popular browser, yet web developers constantly complain about it.

buildup.text: Apple updates Safari only with iOS releases, meaning new features arrive once a year at most.

discovery.text: Features like push notifications and PWA support arrived in Safari years after other browsers.

twist.text: Critics say Apple deliberately slows web progress to protect its App Store revenue.

climax.text: Safari became the 'new IE' — a dominant browser holding back web standards.

punchline.text: The gatekeeper can also be the bottleneck.

quiz.question: Why do developers call Safari 'the new IE'?
options: It's slow to adopt web standards
